pins.title: 63 parks, one hike each
pins.sub: A beginner-friendly day hike for every park in miles and km, plus visit logs and stamp boxes.

pins.kicker: For the day that goes wrong
pins.title: Three safety guides in one
items: Hiking Safety Guide: 10 chapters on what goes wrong
Emergency Checklist: your kit and pre-trip check
What To Do If You Get Lost, with a pocket card
Letter, A4 and mobile versions of each
pins.sub: $16.99 instead of $20.97 bought separately. Instant PDF download.

pins.title: Wear blaze orange
pins.sub: Orange hat and vest seen from every side, no white or brown layers, and this year's dates from your state wildlife agency.

pins.title: Pack for two seasons
pins.sub: Desert days can feel mild, but Bryce Canyon sits above 8,000 ft. Expect freezing mornings and check nps.gov for snow and road updates.

pins.title: Gloves on before you chill
pins.sub: Put them on at the trailhead, keep a dry spare pair in a bag, and keep eating and drinking so your body can make heat.
